summary: Completed testing of chat bug fixes: 1) Chat sidebar preview text now displays correctly (not showing ':::::' characters), 2) Real-time message polling works correctly - new messages appear without page refresh. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all chat features work correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fix verified: Chat sidebar preview text (line 749 in ChatPage.js) now uses text-zinc-400 class and displays actual message content instead of ':::::' characters
Bug fix verified: Real-time polling implemented correctly - threads poll every 5 seconds (line 331-333), messages poll every 2 seconds (line 347-349)
Polling uses 'after' parameter correctly to fetch only new messages (line 293-294)
Thread list updates with latest message preview via last_message field from backend
Animated emojis display correctly using Google Noto Emoji animated webp images
seed_data_creation: Test messages and group chats created during testing. Test data prefixed with 'TEST_' for identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat functionality fully tested and working. Bug fixes verified: 1) Sidebar preview shows actual text (not ':::::'), 2) Real-time polling works without refresh. Backend endpoints tested: GET /api/chat/threads, GET /api/chat/threads/team, POST /api/chat/threads, GET /api/chat/threads/{id}/messages, POST /api/chat/threads/{id}/messages, GET /api/chat/members. WordPress REST API integration remains MOCKED.

chat_sidebar_preview.details: Sidebar preview text displays actual message content (text-zinc-400 class), not ':::::' characters. Verified via UI screenshots and backend API tests.

real_time_polling.details: Messages poll every 2 seconds using 'after' parameter. Thread list polls every 5 seconds. New messages appear without page refresh.

thread_list_updates.details: Thread list updates with latest message preview via last_message field. Verified message appears in sidebar after sending.

send_messages.details: Messages can be sent successfully via POST /api/chat/threads/{id}/messages. Message appears in chat area immediately.

mobile_sidebar.details: Mobile sidebar opens correctly, shows conversations, no ':::::' characters found.

private_chats.details: Private chat creation works via POST /api/chat/threads with type='private'. Member selection UI works correctly.

group_chats.details: Group chat creation works via POST /api/chat/threads with type='group'. Group name and member selection UI works correctly.

animated_emojis.details: Animated emojis display correctly in chat messages using Google Noto Emoji animated webp images. Emoji picker available via emoji button.
